profile.headline: Staff Data Engineer at BrightAI
profile.summary:
Specialties:
Bioinformatics
Cloud-based Architectures (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda, etc.)
Software Development (C++, Python, Rust, shell scripting, etc.)
Microservice and Event-driven Architectures
Bio-medical databases
Data analysis pipelines
Big Data
FDA-regulated software development environments

positions.title: Associate Director, Software Engineering, Genomics
positions.description: Responsible for AmpliSeq Designer pipeline - primer design pipeline for targeted NGS.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on AmpliSeq Pipeline - Primer design pipeline for Targeted NGS.

positions.title: Senior Director Software Engineering
positions.description:
Responsible for Software Engineering department at GenomeDx.
Projects included:
- Laboratory Information System (LIS) implemented used SalesForce
- Cancer Informatics Pipeline - Implementing GenomeDx's Decipher analysis and reporting, implemented in AWS.
- GRID - Database and infrastructure supporting research and analysis on 1.4 Million markers for over 50,000 samples in R or other statistical platforms

positions.title: Manager Scientific Programming
positions.description:
Responsible for teams developing and maintaining Affy Power Tools (APT) suite of cross-platform  microarray data analysis tools, and Chromosome Analysis Suite (ChAS) tools for visualizing and exploring chromosome abnormalities.

Architect and contributor for Affymetrix Power Tools, including APT2 framework.

positions.title: Group Lead - Scientific and Institutional Applications
positions.description: Development and support of various institutional software applications and infrastructure.

positions.title: Chief Information Officer
positions.description: Developing data management software for bio-medical and research applications.

positions.title: Senior Director
positions.description: Primarily involved in the GeneExpress product software. Also involved in Ascenta and  other projects.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
Working on OPM project, building data management tools for bioinformatics applications.

Responsible for development of OPM Multidatabase Query Tools
